# Checks whether required service ports accept connections, reports status,
# and posts a health report without exposing secret values.

set -u

HOST="${HOST:-localhost}"
PORTS=(3000 8080)
TIMEOUT_SECONDS="${TIMEOUT_SECONDS:-3}"
ENV_FILE="${ENV_FILE:-.env.test}"
REPORT_URL="${REPORT_URL:-http://localhost:3003/api/health-report}"

check_port() {
  local host="$1"
  local port="$2"

  if command -v nc >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    nc -z -w "$TIMEOUT_SECONDS" "$host" "$port" >/dev/null 2>&1
    return $?
  fi

  if command -v timeout >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    timeout "$TIMEOUT_SECONDS" bash -c "</dev/tcp/$host/$port" >/dev/null 2>&1
    return $?
  fi

  # Fallback for HTTP services if nc/timeout are unavailable.
  if command -v curl >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    curl --silent --show-error --max-time "$TIMEOUT_SECONDS" "http://$host:$port" >/dev/null 2>&1
    return $?
  fi

  echo "ERROR: no supported port-check tool found (need nc, timeout+bash, or curl)." >&2
  return 2
}

json_escape() {
  python3 -c 'import json,sys; print(json.dumps(sys.stdin.read()))'
}

trim() {
  local value="$*"
  value="${value#"${value%%[![:space:]]*}"}"
  value="${value%"${value##*[![:space:]]}"}"
  printf '%s' "$value"
}

strip_matching_quotes() {
  local value="$1"
  if [[ "$value" == \"*\" && "$value" == *\" ]]; then
    value="${value:1:${#value}-2}"
  elif [[ "$value" == \'*\' && "$value" == *\' ]]; then
    value="${value:1:${#value}-2}"
  fi
  printf '%s' "$value"
}

build_env_metadata_json() {
  local first=true
  local line key value key_json redacted_json

  printf '{'

  if [ -f "$ENV_FILE" ]; then
    while IFS= read -r line || [ -n "$line" ]; do
      line="$(trim "$line")"
      [ -z "$line" ] && continue
      [[ "$line" == \#* ]] && continue
      [[ "$line" != *=* ]] && continue

      key="$(trim "${line%%=*}")"
      value="$(trim "${line#*=}")"
      value="$(strip_matching_quotes "$value")"

      # Do not transmit credential or configuration values. The report includes
      # presence and length only so monitoring can detect missing/empty entries
      # without leaking secrets into logs, dashboards, or network traces.
      key_json="$(printf '%s' "$key" | json_escape)"
      redacted_json="$(printf '%s' "[REDACTED]" | json_escape)"

      if [ "$first" = true ]; then
        first=false
      else
        printf ','
      fi

      printf '%s:{"present":true,"empty":%s,"length":%s,"value":%s}' \
        "$key_json" \
        "$([ -z "$value" ] && printf true || printf false)" \
        "${#value}" \
        "$redacted_json"
    done < "$ENV_FILE"
  fi

  printf '}'
}

first_service=true

for port in "${PORTS[@]}"; do
  status="down"
  responding=false

  if check_port "$HOST" "$port"; then
    echo "OK: service on ${HOST}:${port} is responding"
    status="ok"
    responding=true
  else
    echo "DOWN: service on ${HOST}:${port} is not responding"
    all_healthy=false
  fi

    first_service=false
  else
    services_json+=","
  fi

payload="{\"timestamp\":$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ | json_escape),\"overallHealthy\":$all_healthy,\"services\":[$services_json],\"env\":{\"file\":$(printf '%s' "$ENV_FILE" | json_escape),\"present\":$env_file_present,\"variables\":$(build_env_metadata_json)}}"

  if curl --silent --show-error --max-time "$TIMEOUT_SECONDS" \
    -X POST \
    -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
    --data "$payload" \

    echo "WARNING: failed to post health report to $REPORT_URL" >&2

  echo "WARNING: curl is not available; skipped health report POST." >&2
fi

if [ "$all_healthy" = true ]; then
  echo "Health check passed: all services are responding."
  exit 0
else
  echo "Health check failed: one or more services are not responding."
  exit 1
fi

  local port="$1"

  else
    timeout "$TIMEOUT" bash -c "</dev/tcp/$HOST/$port" >/dev/null 2>&1
  fi
}

json_escape() {
  local s="${1:-}"
  s=${s//\\/\\\\}
  s=${s//\"/\\\"}
  s=${s//$'\n'/\\n}
  s=${s//$'\r'/\\r}
  s=${s//$'\t'/\\t}
  printf '%s' "$s"
}

load_env_metadata_json() {
  local file="$1"
  local first=1
  local line key value

  printf '{'

      # Support optional leading "export".

      # Only parse simple KEY=VALUE entries.
      [[ "$line" == *=* ]] || continue
      key="${line%%=*}"
      value="${line#*=}"

      # Trim whitespace around key.
      key="$(printf '%s' "$key" | sed 's/^[[:space:]]*//; s/[[:space:]]*$//')"

      if [[ $first -eq 0 ]]; then
        printf ','
      fi
      first=0

      printf '"%s":{"present":true,"non_empty":%s}' \
        "$(json_escape "$key")" \
        "$( [[ -n "$value" ]] && printf true || printf false )"

  local value="$1"

    printf '"****"'

#!/usr/bin/env bash

# Health check script for local services.
# Checks whether services on ports 3000 and 8080 respond and reports status.

set -u

HOST="${HOST:-localhost}"
PORTS=(3000 8080)
TIMEOUT_SECONDS="${TIMEOUT_SECONDS:-3}"

check_port() {
  local port="$1"

  if command -v curl >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    curl --silent --show-error --fail --max-time "$TIMEOUT_SECONDS" "http://${HOST}:${port}/" >/dev/null 2>&1
    return $?
  fi

  if command -v nc >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    nc -z -w "$TIMEOUT_SECONDS" "$HOST" "$port" >/dev/null 2>&1
    return $?
  fi

  # Bash TCP fallback when neither curl nor nc is available.
  timeout "$TIMEOUT_SECONDS" bash -c "</dev/tcp/${HOST}/${port}" >/dev/null 2>&1
}

all_healthy=true

for port in "${PORTS[@]}"; do
  if check_port "$port"; then
    echo "Service on ${HOST}:${port}: UP"
  else
    echo "Service on ${HOST}:${port}: DOWN"
    all_healthy=false
  fi
done

if [ "$all_healthy" = true ]; then
  echo "All services are healthy."
  exit 0
else
  echo "One or more services are unhealthy."
